cases.testName: ordered Goal queue persists multiple pending contracts without creating concurrent live Goals
cases.expected: Several future Goal contracts can be queued and reordered while exactly one live Goal remains authoritative and unchanged.

cases.testName: completed Goal promotes exactly one queued Goal at session idle with fresh proof state
cases.expected: Only a verified completed Goal may auto-advance at idle, and the promoted Goal starts with a fresh revision, usage/evidence state, and no false stalled turn.

cases.testName: unfinished live Goal never advances the ordered Goal sequence
cases.expected: An unfinished live Goal blocks queue promotion and leaves both the live Goal and queue head unchanged.

cases.testName: sequence activation marker recovers a crash after live promotion without duplicating the Goal
cases.expected: If the process crashes after writing the promoted live Goal but before popping the queue, recovery recognizes the reserved Goal ID and consumes the head exactly once.

cases.testName: sequence activation marker cannot suppress accounting after a real recovered turn
cases.expected: The one-shot activation marker may skip only the pre-turn activation idle; once a real assistant turn has been counted it is removed and normal no-progress accounting applies.

cases.testName: concurrent processes cannot consume more than one queued Goal
cases.expected: The existing process lease serializes competing promoters so exactly one process consumes the queue head and the next item remains pending.

cases.testName: Plan or unknown execution context never auto-promotes a queued Goal
cases.expected: Automatic sequence progression requires a known non-Plan execution binding; restricted or unknown contexts remain inert until explicit user control.

cases.testName: goal doctor reports corrupt queue storage without rewriting it
cases.expected: Read-only storage diagnostics report corrupt ordered-queue persistence and leave the exact queue bytes unchanged.

cases.testName: TUI Goal sidebar is read-only and fails visible on unsafe or corrupt storage
cases.expected: The sidebar projects persisted Goal/queue state without mutation and refuses to display data through unsafe storage paths.

cases.testName: GoalStore rejects a live snapshot whose sessionID does not match its shard
cases.expected: A live snapshot stored under another session's shard fails closed instead of being adopted or listed as trustworthy state.

cases.testName: process lease storage refuses symlink or junction escape before lock creation
cases.expected: Process-lease hardlink portability must not weaken path safety: a symlink/junction lock root is rejected before any external lock or live Goal write.

cases.testName: V2 sequence controls fail closed instead of creating or advancing stable V1 queue state
cases.expected: Stable V1 ordered-sequence controls remain unavailable in the experimental V2 adapter and never create or mutate live Goal state.
